Comfortably pleasant
Oct 2019 • Solo
I walked past the entrance to this bar a few times, as the moving mannequin offering beer caught my attention but it didn't seem that inviting (the alleyway entrance is adorned with clothing for sale).

The bar\restaurant is up an un-inviting alley off one of the main roads, but the level of comfort is that of a boutique.Lovely, smart decor. 

I only stopped for a quick beer (they sell draft beer in pint glasses) and would maybe have stayed longer if I wasn't the only person here.
A lovely bar. I'd definitely visit again (maybe even later tonight).
